description: Defines structures for various upper PHY metrics related to LDPC, CRC, scrambling, PUSCH, PDSCH, and downlink processing in a wireless communication system.

classes.name: upper_phy_ldpc_metrics
classes.description: Aggregates LDPC decoder, encoder, rate matching, and dematching metrics.

classes.name: upper_phy_mod_demod_evm_metrics
classes.description: Metrics for modulation, demodulation, and EVM calculation.

classes.name: upper_phy_pusch_metrics
classes.description: Aggregates PUSCH processing metrics including channel estimation, equalization, demodulation, and processing.

classes.name: pusch_port_ch_estimator_metrics
classes.description: Metrics for PUSCH port channel estimation.

classes.name: pusch_ta_estimator_metrics
classes.description: Metrics for PUSCH time alignment estimation.

classes.name: pusch_processing_metrics
classes.description: Metrics for PUSCH processing including latency, rate, SINR, EVM, and BLER.

classes.name: upper_phy_pdsch_metrics
classes.description: Aggregates PDSCH processing metrics including DM-RS, layer mapping, and processing.

classes.name: pdsch_layermap_precode_metrics
classes.description: Metrics for PDSCH layer mapping and precoding.

classes.name: pdsch_processing_metrics
classes.description: Metrics for PDSCH processing including latency, rate, and throughput.

classes.name: upper_phy_metrics
classes.description: Top-level structure aggregating all upper PHY metrics.
